description: Get information about a frame capture session including total frames and timestamps, and `annotatedFrames` - the frames a user drew on or left a note about, which is where to look first. Reports dbPath and dbFile (ok|missing|replaced|unknown) and warns when the session was read out of a stale handle: replaced means frames recorded since the swap are elsewhere, missing means these rows are freed when this process exits. If the session is absent AND the handle is stale it fails rather than saying not found.

sessionId.description: The frame session ID returned when recording was saved

name: get_frame_session_info
